scope: Character-selection loading notifications and their effect on Break Their Garrison (46073)
root_cause: The 26972 client opened its loading screen using map 0 from the character selection screen. LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD then supplied the server-selected map 1220. The client finished the original screen with map 0 even as map-1220 gameplay packets began. The destination-only handler discarded this finish and kept the login pending. Map::Update consequently skipped Player::Update and VisitNearbyCellsOf, including queued quest refresh, the introduction actor and deferred kill credit. A later ordinary transfer to map 0 cleared the pending login.
repair: Sending LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD for a constructed character arms the existing loading state for initial login. A map-zero finish can acknowledge the server-selected map in this state with the same accepted character GUID and no pending transfer. Ordinary destination equality, ignored pre-construction notifications, deferred packet dispatch until map admission, and exactly-once initialization remain in force. Near and far transfer resets use the ordinary loading state. No quest credit or creature behavior is synthesized.

client_baseline.method: Disposable loopback login/character schemas. Created a level-110 Human Priest in the existing 26972 client. Placed the offline test character beside existing event object 232 before leaving the character-selection screen, and seeded its two unlock prerequisites. Manually published the quest after login using the native worldquest add path.
client_baseline.result: The packet capture showed LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD(1220), followed by LOADING_SCREEN_NOTIFY(0, finished) and movement, with no WORLD_SERVER_INFO on that arrival. The stationary offer remained absent after publication. A real far transfer to Stormwind produced NEW_WORLD(0), a matching finish and one WORLD_SERVER_INFO. This reproduced the loading failure and explained the prior delayed in-zone credit.

repaired_client.login_and_activation: An ordinary matched map-1220 finish initialized once. A second newly created level-110 Human Priest reproduced LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD(1220) followed by a map-zero finish and received WORLD_SERVER_INFO within 4 ms, before movement. Publishing 46073 manually activated it while the character remained beside event 232. The native Illidan portrait, chat and intro text appeared.
repaired_client.kill_and_respawn: A near transfer to Dreadblade spawn 341391 and one controlled lethal hit showed 2 percent immediately in Garrison of the Fel. The character saved on map 1220, zone 7543 with one objective credit. The corpse disappeared and the same Dreadblade returned alive at the same location roughly four minutes after the kill, without a map change or forced respawn.
repaired_client.completion: After logout, seeded only the disposable character's active objective counter from 1 to 39 to test the final step. The client showed 97 percent after relog. A real lethal hit to the respawned Dreadblade triggered World Quest Complete and the Illidan outro portrait and text. The client showed rewards and the database held one completion receipt, zero active rows, and the player remained on map 1220 in zone 7543.
repaired_client.transfers: The client then reached Stormwind and returned to Garrison of the Fel. The packet trace recorded matching map 0 and 1220 finishes with one WORLD_SERVER_INFO per arrival. The completed quest did not reappear on return.

regressions.loading_logout: The source-derived ASAN counterfactual rejected map-zero login finish. The repaired run accepted it, deferred the initial packets until admission, sent once, restored map ticks, rejected the wrong character and rejected map zero for a pending nonzero far transfer. Previous logout regressions and the linked Release logout verification passed.
regressions.world_quests: Test-LegionWorldQuestRotationNative.ps1 -Progression passed the three rotation loads, stationary admission, personal intros, repeated poll, native player/pet/guardian kill progress and one persisted reward. The party case retained one credit each for the pet owner and nearby eligible party member and zero for the distant and ineligible members.
regressions.trial_spirit: Updated the retained initial-login and wrong-map fixtures. The full Trial of the Spirit suite was not run because its isolated database wrapper requires a scratch admin credential that was unavailable. The focused ASAN test and 26972 client exercised the repaired login behavior.

deployment.verification: Rebuilt Release game.lib and confirmed that the final worldserver linked CharacterHandler.obj from it. The staged and deployed worldserver.exe and linker-map pairs matched by SHA-256. The executable matched the isolated client test. Started the deployed worldserver with its canonical configuration, observed a fresh ready message, issued the owned process a graceful shutdown and confirmed exit 0 with empty stderr. Runtime configuration, certificates, DLLs and the bnetserver executable verified by hash.
deployment.diagnostics: The baseline and fixed client server pairs, focused ASAN tests, native rotation regression and canonical startup produced no new or changed crash reports or appended DBErrors, warnings, errors or assertions. Canonical Crashes was empty and DBErrors.log remained zero bytes. No test servers remained running.
deployment.cleanup: Verified 112 archived evidence files against their original bytes. removed.csv records 13 deleted temporary paths totaling 1496641337 bytes, including isolated client and server copies, their private test databases and raw packet captures, and redundant regression executables and symbols. The shared client data remained present after unlinking the two fixture junctions. Retained the verified last-good worldserver executable and linker map in the ignored loading-rollback directory.
